definitions.explanation: A statement of disagreement or opposition.

definitions.gloss: different, unusual (as a prefix in compounds)
definitions.explanation: Used as a prefix in compound words such as 異常 (abnormal) and 異文化 (different culture), not as a standalone noun sense.

examples.japanese: {異|い}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{唱|とな}える→唱える：10467_tonaeru⟧。
{異|い}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挟|はさ}む→挟む：00091_hasamu⟧⟦{余地|よち}→余地：07612_yochi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There is no room for objection.

examples.japanese: {異|い}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{唱|とな}える→唱える：10467_tonaeru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦いなかった→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{異文化|いぶんか}→異文化：15703_ibunka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|ふ}れる→触れる：01984_fureru⟧。
examples.english: To come into contact with a different culture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{異常|いじょう}→異常：01716_ijou⟧な⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：12973_atsusa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
⟦{異国|いこく}→異国：13721_ikoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{地|ち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}{暮|ぐ}らし→一人暮らし：03142_hitorigurashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: I began living alone in a foreign land.

notes:
{異|い} has two main uses: as a noun meaning "objection" and as a prefix/modifier meaning "different" or "unusual." It appears frequently in formal and literary contexts.

AS "OBJECTION":
- {異|い}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{唱|とな}える→唱える：10467_tonaeru⟧: to raise an objection
- {異|い}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挟|はさ}む→挟む：00091_hasamu⟧: to interject an objection
- ⟦{異議|いぎ}なし→異議なし：24195_iginashi⟧: no objection (the usual call of assent in meetings)
- {異存|いぞん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: I have no objection (formal)

AS "DIFFERENT/UNUSUAL" (prefix in compounds):
- ⟦{異常|いじょう}→異常：01716_ijou⟧: abnormal
- ⟦{異動|いどう}→異動：01818_idou⟧: personnel transfer
- ⟦{異議|いぎ}→異議：13552_igi⟧: objection, protest
- ⟦{異国|いこく}→異国：13721_ikoku⟧: foreign country
- ⟦{異文化|いぶんか}→異文化：15703_ibunka⟧: different culture

WATCH OUT:
Alone, the kanji is also read こと in the verb ⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧ (to differ), a formal equivalent of ⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧: ⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧ (a different culture). That is a separate word.
